risks.title: Trade tariffs and retaliatory measures
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned at start of section (strong position), moderate language ('cannot predict the ultimate impact'), new situation in 2025 with US tariff announcements and trade retaliations, geopolitical category with medium weight.

risks.title: Volume declines and weak industrial demand
risks.score_rationale: Risk documented in core report section (2025 results), explicit language ('lower volumes', 'weakened industrial demand trends'), increased trend with 3.7% organic volume decline, macro category with high weight.

risks.title: Rising input costs and raw material prices
risks.score_rationale: Risk central to financial analysis (LIFO impact of 17,956 in 2025), direct language ('rising input costs'), increased trend with LIFO charge vs prior year benefit, industrial category with medium weight.

risks.title: Gross margin compression and product mix
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in results analysis (middle position), moderate language ('partially offset'), stable trend with gross margin of 36.2% vs 36.7%, competition category with medium weight.

risks.title: Foreign currency fluctuation exposure
risks.score_rationale: Risk implicit in segmented analysis (middle position), neutral language ('weaker U.S. dollar'), stable trend with positive impact of 0.4% in 2025, macro category with medium weight.

risks.title: Environmental compliance and certifications
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned but mitigated (early position, reassuring language 'has not had a material adverse effect'), stable trend with ISO 14001 and 9001 certifications in place, environment category with medium weight.

risks.title: Dependence on cyclical economic indicators
risks.score_rationale: Structural risk identified (middle report position), cautious language ('does not have available a more direct correlation'), stable trend, macro category with high weight.
